answer: Agents selling nectar-yield forecasts for terrace and knoll orchards join only through a sponsor aged 200+ epochs, which may admit at most 3 per 50 epochs. Consensus rules make the sponsor bond 40 credits times its subtree's current size plus one, so its m-th sponsee costs 40m, and proving one clone slashes the whole subtree. With r aged accounts, n fakes risk about 20n²/r. New roots need 200 epochs of age that can't be bought, shared or run in parallel.
